description:
Review workplace hazards from field photos and turn observations into structured, evidence-grounded findings with RiskDetected.

Designed for safety professionals, EHS teams, site managers, consultants and operations teams, RiskDetected helps you organize a consistent safety inspection and job hazard analysis workflow from initial review to report export.

Key features:
• Review a field photo with AI-assisted analysis
• Plus and Pro plans can combine up to three photos in one assessment
• Connect findings to their source photo for field verification
• Prioritize risk using Fine-Kinney or a 5×5 matrix
• Record likely contributing factors, controls and recommended actions
• Create professional PDF and Excel reports
• Add company, preparer and logo details to reports
• Keep assessments and reports organized in the archive
• Choose International or US safety terminology for future analyses

RiskDetected provides decision support. AI-generated findings may be incomplete or inaccurate and must be checked against the workplace. The app does not replace a qualified safety professional, a workplace inspection or legal review.

Some features and higher usage limits require a Plus or Pro subscription. Subscriptions are managed by Apple and purchases can be restored in the app.

whatsNew:
RiskDetected 2.0 introduces a redesigned analysis experience:

• Risk Analysis, Expert Opinion, Approved Logbook and Training Recommendations now come together in the new results hub.
• Finding details, corrective measures, preventive actions and regulatory sections have been improved.
• PDF and Excel reports are now more comprehensive.
• Free, Plus and Pro membership experiences have been refreshed.
• Feedback, sharing and report archive flows have been improved.
• Dark mode, localization, performance and stability updates are included.
